The arbiter uses timeout to clear pending, so changing this decision can prematurely abort a transfer or prevent timeout termination.
The response logic reports timeout as part of the designed acknowledgement but does not store or alter the timeout state.
The response logic reports timeout as part of the designed error response but does not store or alter the timeout state.

xbus_err_i decides pending termination in the arbiter, so an asserted or suppressed error can abort a valid transfer or prevent the fault response from being completed.
